responsibility: Provides the primary target header for the IA-64 backend, defining architectural properties, ABI macros, target builtins, storage-layout rules, assembler output conventions, unwind/debug defaults, register and pointer semantics, and the machine_function per-function state. It is the central compile-time configuration layer that ties generic GCC target interfaces to IA-64-specific behavior, with defaults later specialized by subtarget headers such as sysv4.h, linux.h, hpux.h, and vms.h.
same_name_distinction: The declarative target header in the ia64 same-name set: unlike ia64.cc, it does not implement hooks; unlike ia64.md, it is not a machine-description pattern file; and unlike ia64.opt, it does not define command-line options, instead supplying C/C++ macros, enums, target defaults, and backend data structures consumed by the other IA-64 files.
